objections.problem: Every note pair gets the same neighbour-note eighth figure; the tune turns mechanical and busy for a beginner at this tempo.
The passing B4 against the left hand's F3 in bar 2 makes a brief tritone rub.
The phrase ends on an off-beat eighth C instead of a settled long tonic, weakening the cadence.

items.comment: The underlying tune is clear, but the constant ornament figure clutters it; I would restore plain quarters in at least bars 3 and 4.
Plain quarter-note tune with a clear half cadence and pickup; ideal beginner material.
Repeated notes are the character of this tune; the bass roots support it cleanly to the half cadence.

objections.problem: D5 over the bass E3 on beat 4 of bar 12 is an unprepared seventh; it passes quickly to C.
The left hand's leap from C2 to G3 and the eighth run in bar 11 are a stretch for a beginner.

items.comment: A singable, well-shaped melody; the only demands are in the walking left hand.
Stepwise line with good tendency-tone resolutions (F to E over B to C); the downbeat F in bar 2 reads as a normal appoggiatura.

objections.problem: D5 over the left hand's A3 is an unresolved fourth that leaps away instead of resolving by step.
Bars 11 and 12 repeat bars 9 and 10 exactly, with no change to round off the phrase.

items.comment: Easy to play and coherent, but the angular D on beat 3 and the literal repeat make it feel like an exercise.
